display_name: OLED Flagship (LG G5 / Samsung S95F tier)
short_description: Per-pixel OLED with 2,268 nits peak HDR. Brighter than any cinema in highlights — but full-screen content drops to ~331 nits, and your living room isn't pitch dark.

default_display_optics.contrast_notes: Per-pixel OLED — true infinite contrast. contrast_sequential is null; UI should render 'Infinite (OLED)'.

known_limitations: Full-screen brightness drops to ~331 nits due to OLED thermal limits — spec-sheet peak brightness applies only to small bright highlights on dark backgrounds
Living room ambient light erodes the per-pixel black advantage vs. cinema
